cards.card_text: After that, she continues in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.
cards.verse_text: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.
cards.snippet: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.

cards.card_text: True or false: during her thirty-three days of purification after giving birth to a son, the woman may go into the sanctuary as long as she doesn't touch anything sacred.
cards.verse_text: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.
cards.snippet: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.

cards.card_text: After a son, the woman's purification from her bleeding lasts thirty-three days.
cards.verse_text: Then she must continue in purification from her bleeding for sixty-six days.
cards.snippet: Then she must continue in purification from her bleeding for sixty-six days.

cards.card_text: When her days of purification are complete, son or daughter, she brings two offerings to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
cards.verse_text: When the days of her purification are complete, whether for a son or for a daughter, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.
cards.snippet: When the days of her purification are complete, whether for a son or for a daughter, she is…

cards.card_text: First, Moses is to sprinkle the Levites with the water of purification.
cards.verse_text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification.
cards.snippet: …you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification.

cards.verse_text: They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
cards.snippet: …be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.

cards.card_text: The LORD says what the water of purification made from the heifer's ashes is for.
cards.verse_text: They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
cards.snippet: …be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.

cards.card_text: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches that water is unclean until evening.
cards.verse_text: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.

cards.card_text: The priests and Levites do the service of their God and the service of purification, with the singers and gatekeepers right alongside them.
cards.verse_text: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, along with the singers and gatekeepers, as David and his son Solomon had prescribed.
cards.snippet: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, along with the singers and gatekeepers, as David and his son Solomon…

cards.card_text: Then the time of purification under the Law of Moses is complete.
cards.verse_text: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
cards.snippet: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him…

cards.card_text: Now six stone water jars are sitting right there, set out for the Jewish rites of purification.
cards.verse_text: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification.
cards.snippet: …stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification.

cards.card_text: Then the writer says the Son provided purification for sins.
cards.verse_text: After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
cards.snippet: After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty…

cards.card_text: After He provided purification for sins, what did the Son do?
cards.verse_text: After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
